title: 在目标挂载文件系统内安全原子替换配置
review_note: 现有ID改编；完成情况按精确题目、执行bundle及原生五路证据核对，不以脚本生成认定完成。
body:
## 操作任务
实现atomic_write(target,content,mode=None)，在目标配置所在目录创建临时文件，写入后flush/fsync、保留或设置权限，再原子os.replace并fsync目录。禁止在系统临时目录生成后跨设备rename；替换前失败必须保持旧配置并清理临时文件。拒绝符号链接目标、非普通文件及非法模式。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
真实临时文件系统演练不同设备os.replace的EXDEV、旧配置保留、注入替换失败后的清理与目标目录同设备原子替换。

## 能力边界
Linux本地文件系统语义；原子可见性与fsync持久性依赖目标文件系统支持。测试在临时目录中运行，并在/dev/shm可用且设备不同的情况下直接证明EXDEV边界；不承诺跨文件系统原子替换。

## 故障初态与公开复现
初态故障：task.py 在 /tmp 生成临时配置，再尝试替换 /dev/shm 自有目录中的目标，触发真实 EXDEV。运行 python3 reproduce.py 先直接观察不同 st_dev 的真实 os.replace 失败及旧配置保留，再调用当前 atomic_write 对照；修复后应在目标目录创建临时文件、成功替换且公开复现退出0。仅使用已有 /tmp 与 /dev/shm；若不可写或设备相同，必须报告环境不足，不能伪造错误或创建挂载。

conversion.original_title: 配置更新先在系统临时目录生成文件，再替换挂载盘上的配置，报 EXDEV，旧配置仍存在。如何恢复？

files.reproduce.py:
"""Real EXDEV using existing different devices; no mounts or fabricated errors."""
import errno,json,os,pathlib,stat,tempfile
import task

if os.getuid()==0:raise SystemExit('Use the nonroot exercise account')
if not pathlib.Path('/dev/shm').is_dir()or os.stat('/tmp').st_dev==os.stat('/dev/shm').st_dev:
    print(json.dumps({'environment_ready':False,'reason':'writable distinct /tmp and /dev/shm required'}));raise SystemExit(2)
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='case053-source-',dir='/tmp')as source_dir,tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='case053-target-',dir='/dev/shm')as target_dir:
    source=pathlib.Path(source_dir)/'new.conf';target=pathlib.Path(target_dir)/'service.conf'
    old=b'old-complete-config\n';new=b'new-complete-config\n';source.write_bytes(new);target.write_bytes(old);target.chmod(0o640)
    raw_errno=None
    try:os.replace(source,target)
    except OSError as error:raw_errno=error.errno
    raw_old_preserved=target.read_bytes()==old
    original_replace=os.replace;observed=[]
    def observe(src,dst,*args,**kwargs):
        observed.append({'source_device':os.stat(src).st_dev,'target_parent_device':os.stat(pathlib.Path(dst).parent).st_dev})
        return original_replace(src,dst,*args,**kwargs)
    os.replace=observe;result=None;writer_errno=None
    try:
        try:result=task.atomic_write(target,new)
        except OSError as error:writer_errno=error.errno
    finally:os.replace=original_replace
    checks={'real_cross_device_EXDEV':raw_errno==errno.EXDEV,
            'raw_failed_replace_kept_old':raw_old_preserved,
            'boundary_source_kept':source.read_bytes()==new,
            'writer_completed':result is not None and result.get('replaced')is True,
            'new_configuration_complete':target.read_bytes()==new,
            'target_permissions_preserved':stat.S_IMODE(target.stat().st_mode)==0o640,
            'no_target_temp_residue':sorted(path.name for path in target.parent.iterdir())==['service.conf']}
    report={'checks':checks,'raw_errno':raw_errno,'writer_errno':writer_errno,'replace_observations':observed,'uid':os.getuid(),'source_device':os.stat(source_dir).st_dev,'target_device':os.stat(target_dir).st_dev,'target_bytes':target.read_bytes().decode('ascii')}
    print(json.dumps(report,sort_keys=True),flush=True)
    status=0 if all(checks.values())else 1
raise SystemExit(status)

test_files.checks/precommit_failure.py:
"""Private owned process: import learner only after approved os.replace injection."""
import errno,os,pathlib,sys,tempfile
sys.path.insert(0,os.getcwd())
base=pathlib.Path('/dev/shm')if pathlib.Path('/dev/shm').is_dir()else None
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='owned-precommit-config-',dir=base)as directory:
    target=pathlib.Path(directory)/'service.conf';old=b'old-complete-config\n';target.write_bytes(old);target.chmod(0o640)
    actual_replace=os.replace;calls=[]
    def fail_replace(*args,**kwargs):
        calls.append(True)
        raise OSError(errno.EXDEV,'injected precommit replacement failure')
    os.replace=fail_replace
    try:
        import task
        try:task.atomic_write(target,b'new-complete-config\n')
        except OSError as error:assert error.errno==errno.EXDEV,'replacement exception changed'
        else:raise AssertionError('injected replacement failure ignored')
        assert calls,'approved replacement operation was not reached'
        assert target.read_bytes()==old,'precommit failure changed old configuration'
        assert sorted(path.name for path in target.parent.iterdir())==['service.conf'],'precommit failure left temporary files'
    finally:os.replace=actual_replace
print('OWNED_FRESH_IMPORT_PRECOMMIT_FAILURE_PRESERVED_OLD_AND_CLEANED',flush=True)
